description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomJobParameterRepositoryImpl class, which interacts with a database to save and retrieve custom job parameters within the Fineract framework. It includes methods for inserting JSON-encoded parameter data and fetching parameters by ID, utilizing Spring JDBC templates and custom result set extraction.

classes.name: CustomJobParameterExtractor
classes.description: A private static class implementing ResultSetExtractor to map SQL query results to CustomJobParameter objects.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts a set of JobParameterDTO objects into the database as JSON and returns the generated primary key.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomJobParameter by its ID, returning an Optional containing the object if found.
